parameters.content:
## v2 Content Processing Workflow

Processes one ingested topic at a time:
1. Load source documents from Postgres
2. Summarize sources via LLM (key facts, angles, hooks)
3. Generate script + scene-by-scene video prompts via LLM
4. Store script and prompt package in video_prompt_queue
5. Mark topic as ready

Human review happens AFTER this workflow — check video_scripts.review_status.
See docs/content-pipeline.md for full guidance.
